title: PET imaging in patients with brain metastasis-report of the RANO/PET group

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《PET imaging in patients with brain metastasis-report of the RANO/PET group》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Brain metastases (BM) from extracranial cancer are associated with significant morbidity and mortality.

evidence.text: Brain metastases (BM) from extracranial cancer are associated with significant morbidity and mortality.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《PET imaging in patients with brain metastasis-report of the RANO/PET group》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Here, the Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology working group provides recommendations for the use of PET imaging in the clinical management of patients with BM based on evidence from studies validated by histology and/or clinical outcome.
